goal: A visitor can type their email, click Join the waiting list, and see a welcome message confirming they are on the list.
summary: Kane found a real problem: The application is rendering raw serialized Buffer data instead of the actual HTML waiting-list page, preventing users from signing up.

results.objective: Go to http://localhost:7860/demo/?bug=1, type a valid email address into the email input field, click the 'Join the waiting list' button, and verify that a welcome message confirming placement on the list appears on the page.
results.reason: The application is rendering raw serialized Buffer data instead of the actual HTML waiting-list page, preventing users from signing up.

attempts.one_liner: The waiting-list page showed raw serialized data rather than the email signup form.

evidence.one_liner: The waiting-list page showed raw serialized data rather than the email signup form.
